items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I remember John Hammonds -- you know, he used to walk. He was (writing inaudible), you know. He used to go the Savoy Ballroom, Paradise -- Small's Paradise, Connie's Inn. He'd walk all around the Rhythm Club.

ctx.x: Harlem was the showplace of the world. People came from all over to come to Harlem. Used to walk around Harlem all day.
